d:
No Pockets is a track about self-confidence, resilience, and transformation. The artist rejects external advice and embraces their own growth and strength. The lyrics reflect personal struggles, facing darkness, and overcoming past challenges. The hook emphasizes the artist's independence, while the verses highlight their journey toward mastery, self-realization, and staying focused on their goals despite adversity.
Track Name: No Pockets
Written & Performed By: Vichaar
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
Primary Artist: Vichaar
Track Name: No Pockets
Singer/Performed By/Cast: Vichaar
